name: groupmembench_bm25
description: Wraps groupmembench's own BM25 baseline (dataset-native, family D) instead of reimplementing generic BM25 -- same tokenizer/passage-formatting/agent-prompt as upstream so it reproduces their reported 'BM25 matches memory systems' result faithfully, while scoring is left to this repo's own qa_em/qa_f1/qa_llm_judge metrics rather than upstream's own gpt-5 judge loop.
author: Wnsdnl
